scenes.tts: If deleting a protein cannot reveal the pore, what experiment can?
scenes.visual: Title card: Change It While It Works. The three counters N, i and P_open from chapter one, with a question mark over i.
scenes.narration: If deleting a protein cannot reveal the pore, what experiment can?

scenes.tts: In two thousand eleven, Kawashima and colleagues removed both T M C one and T M C two.
scenes.caption: In 2011, Kawashima and colleagues removed both TMC1 and TMC2.
scenes.visual: Label: Kawashima and colleagues, 2011; neonatal mouse hair cells. Two gene icons, Tmc1 and Tmc2, both crossed out.
scenes.narration: In 2011, Kawashima and colleagues removed both TMC1 and TMC2.

scenes.tts: Hair cells lacking both had no conventional current. Putting back either gene restored it.
scenes.visual: A flat current trace. Label: double null, no conventional current. Then two restored traces: plus TMC1, plus TMC2.
scenes.narration: Hair cells lacking both had no conventional current. Putting back either gene restored it.

scenes.tts: That puts the T M C proteins in the pathway. But loss and rescue act on the whole product, so they cannot separate a pore from its helpers.
scenes.caption: That puts the TMC proteins in the pathway. But loss and rescue act on the whole product, so they cannot separate a pore from its helpers.
scenes.visual: All three counters N, i and P_open glow together. Label: requirement and rescue = the product. A pore and a helper side by side give the same flat trace when removed.
scenes.narration: That puts the TMC proteins in the pathway. But loss and rescue act on the whole product, so they cannot separate a pore from its helpers.

scenes.tts: The sharper test keeps the channel working, and changes one amino acid.
scenes.visual: A schematic TMC1 chain with one residue highlighted.
scenes.narration: The sharper test keeps the channel working, and changes one amino acid.

scenes.tts: The Beethoven mouse carries such a change. Methionine four hundred twelve of mouse T M C one becomes lysine.
scenes.caption: The Beethoven mouse carries such a change. Methionine 412 of mouse TMC1 becomes lysine.
scenes.visual: Highlighted residue labelled M412K (mouse protein). Label: Beethoven allele.
scenes.narration: The Beethoven mouse carries such a change. Methionine 412 of mouse TMC1 becomes lysine.

scenes.tts: In two thousand thirteen, Pan and colleagues recorded from inner hair cells lacking T M C two. So every channel had to use T M C one.
scenes.caption: In 2013, Pan and colleagues recorded from inner hair cells lacking Tmc2. So every channel had to use TMC1.
scenes.visual: Label: Pan and colleagues, 2013; neonatal mouse inner hair cells, Tmc2 removed. Every channel drawn with TMC1.
scenes.narration: In 2013, Pan and colleagues recorded from inner hair cells lacking Tmc2. So every channel had to use TMC1.

scenes.tts: Predict. If T M C one only delivered or anchored the channel, what would a point mutation change?
scenes.caption: Predict. If TMC1 only delivered or anchored the channel, what would a point mutation change?
scenes.visual: Text: if TMC1 only delivered or anchored the channel, which counter would change? N, i or P_open?
scenes.narration: Predict. If TMC1 only delivered or anchored the channel, what would a point mutation change?

scenes.tts: If only the delivery of normal channels changed, there would be fewer channels. A coupling defect would mean fewer open. Each open channel would be unchanged.
scenes.visual: The N and P_open counters dim; the i counter stays unchanged. Label: delivery or coupling of otherwise normal channels predicts this.
scenes.narration: If only the delivery of normal channels changed, there would be fewer channels. A coupling defect would mean fewer open. Each open channel would be unchanged.

scenes.tts: But the Beethoven channels let through less calcium. That calcium result has been replicated. Whether the single-channel current also shrinks is disputed.
scenes.visual: Two-row table: one wild-type Tmc1 allele, normal calcium permeability; Beethoven Tmc1, reduced calcium permeability. Fewer calcium icons pass the mutant channel. Small note: single-channel current, disputed.
scenes.narration: But the Beethoven channels let through less calcium. That calcium result has been replicated. Whether the single-channel current also shrinks is disputed.

scenes.tts: One residue in T M C one changed which ions pass. A deletion can never show that.
scenes.caption: One residue in TMC1 changed which ions pass. A deletion can never show that.
scenes.visual: A selectivity label glows beside the open channel; the i counter stays unlit. Label: a residue changed which ions pass.
scenes.narration: One residue in TMC1 changed which ions pass. A deletion can never show that.

scenes.tts: But a partner beside the pore can also change what passes. So this rung narrows the candidates.
scenes.visual: A partner shape slides beside the pore. Label: strong, not conclusive.
scenes.narration: But a partner beside the pore can also change what passes. So this rung narrows the candidates.

scenes.tts: Next, change the channel while it works. In two thousand eighteen, Pan and colleagues made T M C one with single cysteine substitutions.
scenes.caption: Next, change the channel while it works. In 2018, Pan and colleagues made TMC1 with single cysteine substitutions.
scenes.visual: Label: Pan and colleagues, 2018. TMC1 chains, each with one residue swapped for cysteine.
scenes.narration: Next, change the channel while it works. In 2018, Pan and colleagues made TMC1 with single cysteine substitutions.

scenes.tts: Delivered into hair cells lacking both genes, they restored a current.
scenes.visual: A viral particle delivers the gene into a double-null hair cell; a current trace appears.
scenes.narration: Delivered into hair cells lacking both genes, they restored a current.

scenes.tts: Then they added a reagent that cannot cross the membrane. It reacts with cysteine in water.
scenes.visual: A reagent cloud outside the cell; the membrane blocks it. Label: membrane-impermeant, reacts with cysteine in water.
scenes.narration: Then they added a reagent that cannot cross the membrane. It reacts with cysteine in water.

scenes.tts: Predict. The current is already flowing when the reagent arrives. If permeation changes, what does that rule out?
scenes.visual: The trace is already running; the reagent arrives. Text: what does a change now rule out?
scenes.narration: Predict. The current is already flowing when the reagent arrives. If permeation changes, what does that rule out?

scenes.tts: It rules out altered synthesis or delivery. The current existed before the reagent was added.
scenes.visual: Synthesis and delivery cards cross out. Label: current existed first.
scenes.narration: It rules out altered synthesis or delivery. The current existed before the reagent was added.

scenes.tts: A residue reached from outside, whose change alters which ions pass, points to a water-filled route. That is what a pore would provide.
scenes.visual: The reagent reaches a cysteine on a water-accessible path open to the outside; the ions passing change. Label: as a pore would provide.
scenes.narration: A residue reached from outside, whose change alters which ions pass, points to a water-filled route. That is what a pore would provide.

scenes.tts: The cells still had their native partners, and a reachable residue may sit beside the pore. No purified mammalian T M C one was tested alone.
scenes.caption: The cells still had their native partners, and a reachable residue may sit beside the pore. No purified mammalian TMC1 was tested alone.
scenes.visual: Partner shapes still sit beside the channel in the cultured cell. Labels: native partners present; lining the pore or beside it?
scenes.narration: The cells still had their native partners, and a reachable residue may sit beside the pore. No purified mammalian TMC1 was tested alone.

scenes.tts: Purified, truncated turtle T M C one and budgerigar T M C two, in liposomes, responded to pressure.
scenes.caption: Purified, truncated turtle TMC1 and budgerigar TMC2, in liposomes, responded to pressure.
scenes.visual: Label: Jia and colleagues, 2020; truncated constructs. Lipid vesicles with purified protein; a pressure arrow; channel activity appears.
scenes.narration: Purified, truncated turtle TMC1 and budgerigar TMC2, in liposomes, responded to pressure.

scenes.tts: That supports force-gated activity in a reduced system. The proteins were not mammalian, and this was not a native complex.
scenes.visual: Label: supports force-gated activity in a reduced system; non-mammalian; not a native complex.
scenes.narration: That supports force-gated activity in a reduced system. The proteins were not mammalian, and this was not a native complex.

scenes.tts: Each rung ruled out a different alternative. None alone proves the pore.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: the ladder of rungs, each labelled with what it ruled out.
scenes.narration: Each rung ruled out a different alternative. None alone proves the pore.
